description: Recent earthquakes from the USGS: filter by bounding box or center point + radius, minimum magnitude and time window (last N days or start/end dates). Returns magnitude, place, time, coordinates, depth, tsunami flag, PAGER alert, felt reports and USGS event links. Price: $0.01 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/earthquakes

days.description: Look-back window in days when start is not set (1-365, default 7)

minlat.description: Bounding box south latitude (use all four box params)

name: earthquakes
title: Earthquakes
